import json,collections
cards=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
answers=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(cards)==len(answers)
assert [x['card_id'] for x in cards]==[x['card_id'] for x in answers]
assert len({x['card_id'] for x in answers})==len(answers)
for x in answers:
 assert set(['card_id','letters','marks','crop_ok','errors','detail','owner_crop','where'])<=x.keys()
 assert x['letters'] in ['y','n','u'] and x['marks'] in ['y','n','na'] and x['crop_ok'] in ['y','n']
 assert len(x['owner_crop'])==5 and all(v in ['yes','no','uncertain'] for v in x['owner_crop'].values())
 assert all(set(v)=={'label','printed'} for v in x['where'])
print('Count and order verified:',len(answers))
for k in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']:print(k,dict(collections.Counter(x[k] for x in answers)))
print('Errors:',collections.Counter(e for x in answers for e in x['errors']).most_common())
